name: Kettlebell Around-the-Body Pass to Squat
description: A combo: pass the bell around the body in a full circle — hand to hand, behind the back and across the front — then drop straight into a squat before the next pass. The around-the-body pass loads the core, obliques, grip, and shoulders to resist the rotational pull while the torso stays tall and still; the squat between passes keeps the legs honest. Brace the core through the pass, then sit to full depth with the chest up. Alternate pass direction so both sides rotate evenly. Light-to-moderate bell, smooth and continuous — coordination and conditioning, not load.
